headline: Argentine Vehicle Registrations Drop 8.4% in October, ACARA Reports
summary: Vehicle registrations in Argentina fell 8.4% in October compared with the previous month and dropped 12.8% year-on-year, according to auto dealers association Acara.
why: Automobile sales provide a direct gauge of domestic consumer demand, purchasing power, and industrial activity in Argentina.
